statusMeaning.active: The public library, evidence layer, research tooling and agent-facing distribution continue to be maintained.
statusMeaning.maintained-public-project: The site is publicly usable and versioned, while research tracks retain explicit maturity states rather than being presented as universally settled findings.

events.title: Repository created
events.summary: The Cognitive Biases website repository was created as the public home for the educational product and its knowledge base.

events.title: Agent-Ready Web Profile baseline published
events.summary: The Pages build began publishing and advertising a machine-readable ARWP site profile, with dedicated CI validation.

events.title: AI discovery and search surfaces expanded
events.summary: The project added a fuller AI discovery guide and a Google Search indexing workflow while keeping canonical pages and public data as the source of record.

events.title: Monthly evidence loop and Research Lab matured
events.summary: Monthly evidence deltas, broader research scouting, an Evidence Change Log and a public Research Lab maturity surface were added to make changes and research status more inspectable.

events.title: ARWP search, citation, localization and trust layers aligned
events.summary: The site now exposes multilingual agent routing, product history, an AI Search & Citation Profile, a citation index, a Trust Center, a corrections ledger and a JSON-LD knowledge graph. Planned modules remain explicitly marked as planned or not applicable.
